reason: An Electron desktop shell that launches an existing local dsh web server and presents its GUI in a standalone tray-resident window.

summaries.zh: 将本机已有的 dsh Web GUI 封装为支持托盘驻留的跨平台 Electron 桌面窗口。
summaries.en: A cross-platform Electron desktop shell that launches an existing local dsh web server and hosts its GUI in a tray-resident standalone window.

capabilities: Launches a locally installed dsh web process
Hosts the dsh web GUI in a sandboxed Electron window
Maintains tray residency and controls the local server lifecycle
Opens permitted external http(s) links in the system browser
